estimate.description: Estimate carbon on a parcel and optionally attach an iwi/hapū attestation.
estimate.parcel_arg: Path to a GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon describing the parcel.
estimate.attestation_opt: Path to an attestation JSON document.
estimate.locale_opt: Display locale for CLI messages (en or mi).
estimate.verbose_opt: Print full working output (not just the headline estimate).
estimate.running: Computing biomass → stored carbon → CO2-equivalent for parcel.
estimate.no_attestation: No attestation attached. Output is a numeric estimate only.
estimate.attestation_attached: Attestation attached. Output preserves iwi provenance.
estimate.input_not_polygon: GeoJSON is not a Polygon or MultiPolygon (got {type}).

errors.locale_unknown: Unknown locale '{locale}' — falling back to English.

schema.bad_iwi_name: Field 'iwi' must be a non-empty string.
schema.bad_scope: Field 'scope' must be one of: parcel, papakainga, collective, research.
